why: Both identify replay error merging that compares Unix-second error timestamps with millisecond recording timestamps without conversion, causing incorrect chronological ordering.
Both describe non-atomic recovery-code consumption from a stale snapshot, allowing concurrent requests to reuse the same code or restore codes consumed by another request.
Both identify background legacy-write failures being reduced to boolean metrics without logging the actual error and operation/object context needed to diagnose safety-copy divergence.
Both describe confirmation-required collective bookings reconstructing only the persisted organizer destination, leaving co-host calendars out of deferred event creation.
Both identify the obsolete ruler-preload description in prometheusGroupsGenerator.ts after the block stopped prefetching ruler rules and became Prometheus-cache-only.
Both identify BSD-specific sed syntax breaking existing GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL replacement on GNU/Linux and an unchecked failure followed by a success message.
Both identify Lark's app-token acquisition before external/native routing as an unnecessary dependency that can block external refresh when local app-ticket state is unavailable.
Both identify BSD-specific sed syntax failing on GNU sed and an unchecked replacement that leaves the old webhook URL in place while reporting success.
Both identify replacement imports updating only `key` without clearing `invalid`, leaving successfully replaced credentials excluded from calendar operations.
Both identify that the graceful-shutdown test checks factory.queue_pool clearing instead of verifying that every distinct accepted result finishes, allowing abandoned work to go unnoticed.

No comment requests updating the sqlExpressions toggle description or generated documentation to reflect unconditional disablement; the comments instead address error messaging and hiding the SQL operation.
Both describe overlapping deployments where old cancellation workers delete only the first external event but remove all database references, losing cleanup identifiers for co-host events.
Both request preserving Teams’ native fallback material when refreshing externally managed credentials.
Both identify the Lithuanian login bundle’s loginTotpStep1 instruction being replaced with Italian, causing OTP enrollment to start in the wrong language.
Both describe how five successful 80% reductions can still leave valid images above the configured storage limit, causing rejection.
Both describe the unsubscribe endpoint dereferencing a nil TopicUser returned by find_by when an authorized user has no existing topic preference row.
Both identify misleading assurances in the base and optimized pagination paths that Django handles negative slice boundaries, encouraging reliance on behavior Django explicitly rejects.
Both identify the Italian authenticator setup instruction in the Lithuanian account bundle and request a Lithuanian, link-free translation.
Both identify the category-count color override in common/base/_topic-list.scss:115 as needing conversion to theme-dependent coloring.
Both identify the account bundle’s Simplified Chinese authenticator setup instruction as incorrectly introducing Traditional Chinese characters and terminology.
Both describe override selection using unconverted endpoints while time conversion uses organizer-adjusted endpoints, omitting correct-day availability and attaching it to the wrong attendee day.
